interactables.text: The [Gardener] is trimming the same hedge for the fourth time. 'Animals belong in [Nature]. Cages are cruel. I... I didn't do anything wrong.'
Heavy iron [Pruning Shears] left near the fountain. The blade tips are [slightly bent] — the kind of bend you'd get forcing a metal latch.
A stone bird bath near the hedgerow. A few [bright feathers] float on the surface — Rudebeak's distinctive markings. They're fresh. He was here [this morning].

localDeductionSentence: [The Gardener] insists birds belong in nature — and his [Bent Shears] match the cage's snapped latch. He freed Rudebeak... but he didn't take him.
